component.name: SN30 Pro+
component.summary: Firmware for the 8BitDo SN30 Pro+ Game Controller

description.p: Updating the firmware on your SN30 Pro+ device improves performance and adds new features.
This stable release fixes the following issues:

ul.li: The button combo to activate/deactivate the profile has changed to [L3+R3+L1+R1].
Optimized the dead zone range of the analog sticks in Xinput mode.
Optimized the vibration of the Switch mode.
Fixed the abnormal vibration issue in Switch mode.
Fixed the abnormal vibration issue when connecting to the PS Retro Receiver.

screenshot.caption: Unplug the controller, hold down L1 + R1 + START until the red LED on top of the controller is flashing and then reconnect the controller.
